conditions.description: WHERE conditions for the SOQL query (e.g., 'Name = \'John\' AND Revenue >= 100000')

search_term.description: The search term for the SOSL query (e.g., 'Burlington Textil')

tools.description: Generate or build an OmniScript for a specific use case. OmniScript is a tool that allows you to create a script that can be used to automate a process and user workflow.

confirm_sanitize_false.description: SECURITY CRITICAL - HUMAN USER CONFIRMATION ONLY: Set to true ONLY after the human user has explicitly confirmed they understand XSS security risks. AI assistants MUST NOT automatically set this to true. This confirmation is required when any Text Block element has sanitize set to false. WAIT for user to explicitly say 'I understand the risks and confirm sanitize: false' before setting this to true.

Description.description: The description for the OmniScript, its very similar to the omniscript's use_case attribute but its more detailed and provides more context to the Customers in addition to the use_case attribute, the length is no more than 255 characters

Language.description: The language for the OmniScript, default to English

Type.description: Alphanumeric characters only. Default to the use_case attribute after removing the spaces and converting to lowercase. The type of the OmniScript, its a generic description of what the OmniScript is for and what it does functionally, the length is no more than 50 characters and it shall not contain spaces or special characters, if there is no use_case explicitly mentioned then put something that you get from the context of the user input

SubType.description: Alphanumeric characters only. Default to the use_case attribute after removing the spaces and converting to lowercase and shorten it. tools.name: os_modify
tools.description: Updates an existing OmniScript element properties, adds new elements/steps, and PERMANENTLY DELETES elements/steps using comprehensive template-based guidance with intelligent property validation. Supports single element updates, multiple property updates on single element, multiple element updates, adding new elements, adding new steps, removing single elements, removing multiple elements, and removing steps in one call for maximum efficiency. Features: 1) Template-based property documentation system, 2) Property name validation with helpful suggestions for typos, 3) Element type-specific property validation, 4) Add new elements to steps, 5) Add new steps to OmniScript, 6) PERMANENTLY DELETE single elements from steps (NOT just hide them), 7) PERMANENTLY DELETE multiple elements in one operation, 8) PERMANENTLY DELETE entire steps, 9) Comprehensive error handling and guidance, 10) DUAL IDENTIFICATION METHODS: Supports both direct OmniScript ID and Type/SubType/Language identification for backward compatibility and flexibility. IDENTIFICATION: Use either 'omniprocess_id' OR all three fields ('Type', 'SubType', 'Language') to identify the target OmniScript. When using Type/SubType/Language, the tool automatically selects the latest version if multiple versions exist. IMPORTANT: Property names must be exact - the tool will NOT automatically apply suggestions to prevent accidental changes. Users must manually provide the correct property name. INDEXING: Uses zero-based indexing - first step/element = 0, second = 1, third = 2, etc. WARNING: Element/step removal is PERMANENT and cannot be undone - elements are deleted from Salesforce database, not just hidden.
